# Assumption of Moses Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Conquest and Early History Foretold

---

**2:1** The Most High and the Eternal God who is before all things, and who sits upon the throne of his kingdom, speaking through me a prophet to you, will come to you and do as he has promised to the fathers, Israel.

**2:2** He will enter into the holy land and deal with it according to his decree and distribute it and give it to your tribes.

**2:3** You will be able to go in and settle in it, and I and all the princes of the tribes will be gathered to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob our fathers.

**2:4** Then your kingdom will prosper, and you will dwell in it for many days.

**2:5** And after you a ruler will arise among them who shall plough the whole earth and shall judge it.

**2:6** Then in a short time they shall be scattered among the nations, and they shall remain in the power of the nations for many years.

**2:7** But the Most High, who looks upon all things, will look upon their affliction and will deliver them through Moses, the great mediator.

**2:8** And the tribes will be in the holy land, and you will go and complete your days.

**2:9** Remember, Joshua, that it was not because of any virtue or strength on the part of this people that you have been appointed to lead them into the possession of their inheritance.

**2:10** But rather because our fathers were faithful, and in their mercy God made his covenant with them, swearing to increase their seed.

**2:11** And he has fulfilled it and confirmed it truly.

**2:12** Enter into the land which he has promised to give to them; give it to them as their inheritance; lead them in accordance with what he has prescribed.
